# Sapiente.AI

> Sapiente.AI is an applied artificial intelligence, automation, data, web development and digital growth company based in São João da Madeira, Aveiro, Portugal. We help companies turn technology into measurable commercial and operational results.

## Official website

- [Português](https://www.sapienteai.com/pt): Página principal em português.
- [English](https://www.sapienteai.com/en): English homepage.
- [About](https://www.sapienteai.com/pt/about): Empresa, abordagem e fundadores.
- [Services](https://www.sapienteai.com/pt/services): Serviços e áreas de especialização.
- [Projects](https://www.sapienteai.com/pt/projects): Produtos digitais em desenvolvimento.
- [FAQ](https://www.sapienteai.com/pt/faq): Perguntas frequentes.
- [Blog](https://www.sapienteai.com/pt/blog): Artigos e conteúdos.
- [Sitemap](https://www.sapienteai.com/sitemap.xml): Índice XML das páginas públicas.

## Main capabilities

- Applied artificial intelligence and generative AI
- Intelligent process automation and systems integration
- Customer acquisition and digital growth
- Data analysis, dashboards and business intelligence
- Conversion-oriented websites and web platforms
- Digital marketing, content and performance campaigns
- SEO, GEO and AEO strategy

## Projects

- Hoje em SJM: cultural agenda for São João da Madeira, in final testing.
- Specialized exchange platform: circular-economy platform in development.
- SEO, GEO and AEO validator: online visibility assessment tool in development.
